snippet.title: Pathogenic Release Date Trailer - Cellular Combat Evolved
snippet.description:
🦠 Pathogenic is OUT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3808690/Pathogenic/

In Pathogenic, you ARE the disease. Become the infection in a 2D roguelike twin-stick shooter - a lone parasite, fighting a biological war. Collect organelles to evolve your cell in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.
